svg.title: Hand size
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: hand size set to Large. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket, removed. 2, the finger holes: the two large holes in the lower half. 3, the zip-tie holes, the wing openings, the wall notch and the body edge.
